label: Text to File
description: Store text as a file and emit its reference, for a node that takes a file (an upload, an attachment, an LLM conversation file) or to move text on as a file instead of a value. Plain text unless `mimeType` says otherwise. FileToText reads it back.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.label: Filename
inputs.description: Stored filename (what a download calls it).

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Store in
inputs.description: `execution`: only this run can read it. `project`: every later run can.

inputs.name: ttl_days
inputs.label: Keep for (days, 0 = forever)
inputs.description: Lifetime since last access (any read, download or presign resets it); 0 never expires. Empty: an execution file is swept soon after its run, a project file lives until deleted.
